title: Solana Helius and RPC normalization adapter
objective: Implement a fixture-testable Solana adapter boundary for token metadata, holders, transactions, transfers, wallet facts and source watermarks without requiring a live key in tests.
forbidden_actions: Do not persist or print API keys.
Do not use Dexscreener as an on-chain fact source.
Do not modify domain rule semantics or future-chain code.
